sections.question: What was the operating profit margin of Colgate's North America segment, as the company defined that segment from 2026, for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026? Give it as a percentage of the segment's net sales, to two decimal places.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 12: the segment tables were recast to conform to the reporting structure effective for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. North America had net sales of 1,779 and operating profit of 333 in the six months ended June 30, 2026, against recast net sales of 1,823 and operating profit of 384 in the six months ended June 30, 2025 (dollars in millions).

Step 2. Doc 10: on the same recast basis, North America had full-year 2025 net sales of 3,679 and operating profit of 790.

Step 3. Doc 10 and Doc 12: net sales for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026 were 3,679 - 1,823 + 1,779 = 3,635.

Step 4. Doc 10 and Doc 12: operating profit for the same twelve months was 790 - 384 + 333 = 739.

Step 5. Doc 10 and Doc 12: the operating profit margin was 739 / 3,635 = 20.33% (to two decimal places).

Decoy: Doc 9 reports full-year 2025 North America net sales of 4,045 and operating profit of 784 but those figures follow the segment structure used before 2026, so combining them with the recast six-month figures gives a different and wrong margin.
